categories.main_business_segments: Angang Steel Company Limited primarily engages in steel manufacturing with diversified products including hot-rolled coils, medium and thick plates, cold-rolled plates, galvanized plates, color-coated plates, cold-rolled silicon steel, heavy rails, profiles, seamless steel pipes, and wire rods. The company also focuses on strategic emerging industries such as new carbon materials, new energy, and resource recycling, supporting high-quality development in these sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced steelmaking technologies including low-carbon metallurgy, clean steel smelting, efficient rolling, big data-based process control, and energy-saving environmental protection. It has developed proprietary technologies for corrosion-resistant steel for marine structures, high-strength automotive steel, and high-performance rails, among others. Digital transformation and AI integration are also key in its intelligent manufacturing and R&D processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Angang Steel serves a broad range of industries including machinery, metallurgy, petroleum, chemical, coal, electric power, railways, shipbuilding, automotive, construction, home appliances, and aviation. It holds leading market shares in steel for railway vehicles, nuclear power, and high-end pipeline steel, and supplies major customers such as CIMC Container and Haier Home Automation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with three major production bases in Anshan, Yingkou, and Chaoyang, and sales and service agencies in major Chinese cities including Dalian, Shenyang, Changchun, Tianjin, Shanghai, Wuhan, Hefei, Zhengzhou, and Guangzhou. It also leverages Angang Group’s overseas sales agencies for international operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: Angang Steel operates primarily in the midstream segment of the steel supply chain, focusing on steel production and processing. It integrates upstream raw material resources through Angang Group’s iron ore assets and downstream sales and distribution through its extensive sales network and service agencies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in advanced steel materials for emerging industries such as new energy vehicles, marine engineering, and nuclear power. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on breakthrough technologies in corrosion resistance, low-carbon steel production, high-strength materials, and digital transformation including AI and big data. It also emphasizes green and low-carbon development aligned with national carbon reduction goals.
categories.revenue_model: Angang Steel generates revenue primarily through the sale of steel products across various industries. It employs direct selling and distributorship sales models domestically and internationally, with export sales contributing a smaller portion of total revenue. The company also derives income from investment activities and financial services related to its operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As a major large-scale steel enterprise in China, Angang Steel holds leading market positions in several product categories such as railway steel, nuclear power steel, and high-end pipeline steel. It competes with other large Chinese steel producers and is part of the Angang Group, which is actively restructuring to reduce horizontal competition within affiliated companies. The company is recognized for its strong brand, technological innovation, and comprehensive product range.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Angang Steel reported operating income of RMB 105.1 billion, a 9.06% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.1 billion. Total assets stood at RMB 100.6 billion with a gearing ratio of 51.61%. The company faces challenges from weak market demand and high raw material costs but continues to invest in R&D and digital transformation to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Angang Steel emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced steel products tailored for strategic emerging industries and critical infrastructure sectors. Its value proposition includes strong product innovation, comprehensive quality assurance, and leadership in green and low-carbon steel production. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies, extensive R&D capabilities, and a robust digital transformation strategy enhancing operational efficiency and customer service.
